reviews.title: Difficult to communicate with
reviews.body:
I have been using a Labara data only sim in a wireless router occasionally for a couple of years, with no problems. However, this is no longer working.

After a lot of attempts at troubleshooting trying to fix it, I got in touch with Lebara. After an unpleasant phonecall with one member of their support team, who insisted that I couldn't use my sim card with a router, I eventually chatted with a member of their team, who told me that they do not support use of these sim cards in routers, so they could not help unless it was in a phone. Ok, great, I have a spare phone.  But actually, there was another problem.

They no longer sell pay as you go for a data only sim. So the top up I just paid for (to ensure I had credit since I couldn't see on the app or on my desktop browser) was pointless as I could not use it for data only.

Ok, well, I shall just have to use a 30 day plan instead, which means I will waste data I have paid for, but oh well. The support assistant also told me they would take back the pay as you go I had just purchased an send a refund. I would get notification of this shortly.

I have not received notification of this, so wrote Lebara an email asking them to send me the refund details. The mail came back "because their inbox is full"

Ok, no worries, i shall email them via the website. But no, i can't. Even though i have entered a description of what happened in the "tell us more" form field, the website is giving me a warning telling me I need to "Please describe what happened so we can assist you better"

I hope Lebara sorts out these communication problems. It was very frustrating. I will be looking for another provider after this.

reviews.body:
This is a formal public notice and final escalation to Lebara management. For over 6 months and across more than 68 emails, Lebara has systematically failed to resolve severe contract breaches, instead repeatedly sending generic, automated template responses falsely claiming they will call, threatening to close case files, and continuously disconnecting my phone line. 
Lebara is on explicit notice NOT to cut off my contract on 10/10/26. Disconnecting my line again will directly endanger a vulnerable customer who relies on uninterrupted service to care for critically ill parents. 
Summary of Ongoing Failures & Escalations
•	March 2026: Purchased a 50GB Uswitch plan (£3.18/mo). Lebara failed to port my number (07766 137835), sent incorrect SIM hardware, mis-sold a pricier plan, and three agents (Moin, Rulin, Zeeshaw) hung up on me. Complaints were ignored for a month. 
•	June 2026: Service cut off with no notice. Lebara formally agreed in writing on 12/06/26 to provide a free 6-month 50GB plan to resolve the complaint. 
•	July 2026: Service cut off again. Agent Akshay attempted to blackmail me into deleting my factual Trustpilot reviews under threat of removing my account credit. After I refused to be coerced, my reviews vanished, and Lebara re-confirmed my credit balance and 50GB plan scheduled to auto-renew. 
•	August 2026: Service cut off again on 11/08/26 despite my credit balance. Agent Urvi demanded payment details and hung up when I asked when service would be restored. Agent Rosita subsequently refused reactivation and hung up as well. 
•	September 2026: Service cut off again on 10/09/26. Agent Harshal demanded payment despite my existing credit balance and placed me on hold when presented with written email proof. On 24/09/26, Lebara sent automated templates threatening to close my case while falsely claiming to have called, only to auto-respond with a generic "5-7 days" delay email when I replied immediately. 
•	Current Status & Impending Risk (10/10/26): Lebara has ignored my correspondence for over 4 months while continuing to send useless generic template responses. Across 68 emails, Lebara has refused to fix these errors and is set to cut off my contract again on 10/10/26 based on their monthly cycle, completely ignoring all documented evidence. 
Lebara’s conduct constitutes a continuous breach of the UK Consumer Rights Act and Ofcom’s General Conditions on Customer Vulnerability. 
MANDATORY IMMEDIATE ACTION REQUIRED: Lebara senior management must immediately ensure my contract is NOT disconnected on 10/10/26, fully honor my account credit balance without demanding additional payments, apply the promised plan terms permanently, and pay substantial financial compensation for over 6 months of severe stress, distress, and immense time wasted. This entire evidence log—including all 68 emails, generic template responses, and evidence of review suppression—is filed directly with Ofcom and the Communications Ombudsman. 

Just received again the generic reply to the above message on 08/10/26 as follows:

"Reply from Lebara Mobile (UK)

Hello,

Thanks for taking the time to leave a review. It is very disappointing to hear you feel this way and we would love the chance to put things right. As you left your contact details when leaving the review, a member of my team will reach out to you ASAP.

John-Paul Patten
Business Operations Director"

I have received this exact generic reply over 10 times now. No one contacts myself and Lebara terminate my contract again when i URGENTLY require my phone 24/7 due to looking after sick elderly parents.  Absolutely appalling for Lebara to treat vulnerable carers so badly, ignoring 70 emails + to date.

reviews.title: Excellent network coverage, fantastic app and a hassle-free experience!
reviews.body:
I'm genuinely impressed with Lebara and couldn't be happier with my experience so far!

One of the biggest improvements I've noticed is the network coverage. I was previously with O2, and since switching to Lebara, which uses the Vodafone network, the signal inside my house is significantly better. It's made a real difference.

I've also been really impressed with how easy everything is when travelling abroad. On a recent trip to Turkey, I needed an eSIM, so I purchased one directly through the Lebara app. It was activated instantly, with absolutely no messing around or complicated setup. Everything just worked seamlessly.

I've also just returned from Spain, where I was able to use my data allowance as normal, exactly as I would back home. Another great experience!

The Lebara app itself deserves a special mention. It's incredibly easy to navigate, everything is clearly laid out, and finding what you need is effortless. From a customer experience perspective, I honestly think the app is fantastic. It's simple, intuitive and does exactly what you need it to do without unnecessary complications.

I haven't needed to contact customer services once, simply because everything has worked exactly as it should. To me, that's a very good sign of a company getting things right.

Overall, I'm extremely impressed with Lebara. Great coverage, a brilliant app, straightforward services and excellent value. It's refreshing to use a mobile provider that makes everything so simple.

Very happy I made the switch. Keep up the great work, Lebara!
